currentParagraphText: “And we’re approaching the teleportation hub,” the Godqueen explained to the group. “While it would be entirely possible to teleport without it, using a hub like this is far easier, and there’s already been established a connection with the Order of the Malefic Viper. Finally, seeing as this is the official return of the Chosen of the Malefic Viper and the arrival of the Ambassador from the Pantheon of Life, we should at least keep our transportation to official channels.”
